content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident (Non Academic) Overview

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Raipur (Chhattisgarh)
Rs. 56100/- (Level-10 Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) per month plus usual allowances including NPA
30 years, as on the last date of application
Six (06) months under the Government of India Residency Scheme

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice does not give an interview date or a result date. It asks candidates to visit the institute website regularly for updates.

content_sections.heading: Category-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: AIIMS Raipur has 15 Junior Resident (Non Academic) vacancies in total: UR 07, EWS 01, OBC 04, SC 02 and ST 01. The total includes 01 post of PwBD. Reservation for ST/SC/OBC candidates is as per Central Government rules. Reservation for PwBD candidates is 4% on a horizontal basis. Physical requirements for the post are S, ST, H, W, RW and SE (S = Sitting, ST = Standing, H = Hearing, W = Walking, RW = Reading and Writing, SE = Seeing). The categories of disabled eligible for the post are OL and OA. EWS posts are not carried forward or treated as a backlog vacancy if they remain unfilled. Candidates of other categories may therefore apply provisionally, and they will be considered as UR candidates only if the EWS seat is otherwise not filled.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates who passed MBBS (including Internship) not earlier than two years before the start of Junior Residency, that is, as on the last date of application, will be preferred. DMC/NMC/State Registration is mandatory before joining, if selected. Candidates who joined Junior Residency anywhere else and whose services were terminated for unauthorised absence or any other disciplinary ground are ineligible, even if they otherwise qualify. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. The notice does not print any experience requirement for this post.

rows.qualification: MBBS (including completion of Internship) or equivalent degree recognized by NMC. Only medical graduates who completed their Internship on or between 01.12.2024 and 30.11.2026 will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 30 years as on the last date of application. The notice prints no minimum age.

rows.relaxation: Up to a maximum of 5 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Junior Resident (Non Academic) post carries Rs. 56100/- (Level-10 Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) per month plus usual allowances including NPA. The notice calls it a temporary position. The engagement is for six (06) months under the Government of India Residency Scheme. It is not linked to regular appointment in any circumstance and cannot be regularized at any stage. The appointment is purely on contract basis. If the contract is not extended further, it lapses automatically. Either side can end the appointment at any time by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. The same applies to failure to complete the six months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. The appointee is on whole-time appointment of AIIMS. The appointee must not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, and must not engage in private practice of any kind during the contract. The competent authority may assign any duty as and when required, and no extra or additional allowance is admissible for such assignment. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits of regular Government servants, nor to allowances or facilities given to regular or permanent AIIMS faculty. Leave is governed by the Government of India Residency Scheme. The application form states entitlement of 2½ days of leave for every completed month. If an appointee wishes to apply elsewhere or resign, no NOC, Relieving Letter or Experience Certificate is issued within the first three months of residency after joining AIIMS Raipur.

content_sections.heading: Selection Procedure
content_sections.text: The notice describes two routes: merit for AIIMS Raipur MBBS graduates, and interview for graduates of other institutions. Junior Residency (Non-Academic) is provided first to all AIIMS Raipur MBBS graduates who fulfil the eligibility criteria. Their merit is made on the basis of aggregate marks in the first, second and final Professional examinations. All posts that remain unfilled after allotment to AIIMS Raipur MBBS graduates are offered to other candidates. Selection of candidates of other institutions is done only on the basis of Interview. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and must be paid in online/digital mode only. Applications without the prescribed fee will not be considered. Fee can be paid by NEFT to the account below.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident (Non Academic)
content_sections.text: Submit the duly filled application through the Google Form (link: https://forms.gle/4cWPT7TcPznjA2KP8 ) between 23.11.2026 and 30.11.2026 (5:00 PM). Fill the application proforma available on the AIIMS Raipur website ( www.aiimsraipur.edu.in ) and attach it with the Google Form. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Pay the application fee in online/digital mode if your category is charged. The application form has a checklist item for "Application fees details". Only the online application form is accepted. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted. The application proforma asks for the applicant's personal and contact details, date of birth, category, educational qualification, MBBS attempts for each year, aggregate percentage, registration number and internship completion date. It also asks for any earlier first-year Junior Residency and up to three departments in order of preference. It carries an undertaking and the candidate's signature, and a passport-size self-attested colour photograph is affixed to it. For queries, email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of the following are to be attached with the Google Form: Degrees, certificates and mark sheets (10th/12th/MBBS all years) Age proof Caste certificates Registration Certificate The checklist in the application form lists the following self-attested copies: Certificate of Date of Birth (Class X or XII Certificate) MBBS Mark Sheets (all semesters), MBBS Degree and Internship completion certificate Attempt certificates and MCI/DMC/State registration SC/ST/OBC/PH certificate issued by the competent authority (if applicable) Experience (if any), with No Objection Certificate Copies of any other relevant documents, and details of aggregate percentage in MBBS and MBBS attempts Category certificates must follow these rules: OBC-NCL candidates must produce an OBC-NCL certificate based on the income for Financial Year 2025-2026, in the prescribed Government of India format. They must also submit a declaration that they do not belong to the creamy layer on the last date of application. EWS candidates must produce an 'Income and Asset' certificate valid for the year 2025-2026, as per the format in DoPT O.M. dated 31.01.2019. SC, ST and OBC certificates must be issued by a Tehsildar or above rank authority in the prescribed Government of India format.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Resident (Non Academic) vacancies are there at AIIMS Raipur?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies: UR 07, EWS 01, OBC 04, SC 02 and ST 01. The total includes 01 post of PwBD.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications are accepted through Google Form from 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident (Non Academic)?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS (including completion of Internship) or equivalent degree recognized by NMC. Only medical graduates who completed their Internship on or between 01.12.2024 and 30.11.2026 will be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years as on the last date of application. SC/ST candidates get 5 years' relaxation and OBC candidates 3 years. PwD candidates get up to 5 years (General), 8 years (OBC) or 10 years (SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident (Non Academic)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 56100/- (Level-10 Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) per month plus usual allowances including NPA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident?
faq.answer: General/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs. 1,000/-. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates pay Nil. The fee is non-refundable and payable in online/digital mode only.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident (Non Academic)?
faq.answer: Submit the Google Form given in the notice, and attach the filled application proforma from the AIIMS Raipur website with self-attested documents. Only the online form is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident?
faq.answer: AIIMS Raipur MBBS graduates who fulfil the criteria are considered first, on aggregate marks in the first, second and final Professional examinations. Unfilled posts are offered to other candidates, who are selected only on the basis of Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS Raipur Junior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement for six months under the Government of India Residency Scheme. It cannot be regularized at any stage.

faq.question: Q10. Are allowances paid on top of the Junior Resident pay at AIIMS Raipur?
faq.answer: Yes, the pay of Rs. 56100/- per month is stated plus usual allowances including NPA. No extra or additional allowances are admissible for any extra duty assigned.
